parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, border, facility, custody or care restriction is documented, and sex between same-sex partners has been legal since 1791. Law 13/2019 prohibits gender-identity discrimination in health, housing and public establishments, the 2022 self-ID reform is a climate signal, and a transphobic column was removed with an apology after complaint, with organised Pride since 2003 and a gay head of government since 2019. Against this, bias-crime enforcement is incomplete, there is no hate-crime classification system, and the 2-3 monthly bias-incident count has no denominator or trans breakdown, so violence prevalence is undocumented, not proven low. Friction/microaggressions are documented, but no targeting or state exposure is. This places it moderately below fully documented working-protection regimes.

entry_documents.protection: Anti-discrimination law covers public establishments; no border marker restriction documented.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented interaction between foreign documents and entry screening.

federal_state_facilities.protection: Law 13/2019 prohibits gender-identity discrimination in public establishments.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: No documented facility enforcement practice for visitors.

care_services.exposure: No visitor care denial documented; microaggressions reported rarely to authorities.
care_services.protection: Law 13/2019 covers health care; 2025 decree provides HRT from 16 and surgery from 18 for residents as climate signal.
care_services.interaction: Resident care framework does not document visitor access or refusal practice.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific offence or dress/presentation law documented; transphobic opinion piece circulated in print.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Gender-identity anti-discrimination law in force; piece removed online with public apology after complaint.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile expression was remedied by removal/apology, but bias enforcement is incomplete and unclassified.

minors_guardians.exposure: No visitor or travelling-minor restriction documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Law 14/2019 requires transgender children be respected in gender identity; healthcare consultation covered under 16.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented border, school or care interaction for a visiting minor with guardian.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Two to three all-motive bias incidents per month recorded in 2025, no denominator or trans breakdown; microaggressions reported.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Additional penalties for sexual-orientation-motivated offences; no formal hate-crime registration/classification system.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Raw count cannot be used as trans-violence prevalence; enforcement incompleteness limits recourse.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No functioning hate-crime classification system; local organisation calls for one.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Anti-discrimination law and complaint-led removal/apology show some institutional response.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies documented generally, not for a trans visitor in border, custody or facility encounter.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar explicit equality protection and social tolerance, but 0.85-A documents oversight, discipline and compensation in practice; this dossier has incomplete bias enforcement and no documented visitor remedy, so lower.
Similar protection with brief secondary screening and uncertainty; this dossier documents no detention or border friction, so higher, but lacks the documented tribunal/counsel remedies shown there.
0.55-B has routine secondary screening, delay and possible refusal at entry; no such universal or recurrent exposure is documented here, so materially higher.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is permissive: no state-imposed universal exposure, criminalisation or organised targeting is documented, and law plus examples of institutional response point to acceptance. The negative side is evidential and remedial rather than operative: no trans-specific violence rate, no classification system, incomplete enforcement, and no documented traveller-facing practice for entry, facilities, custody or care. Rating the consequence of outing, not the chance of passing, that combination supports Low Risk at the bottom of the band, above Reduced-Risk friction-only cases but below 0.85 regimes with demonstrably working visitor remedies.
